rationale: AJPES developer/web-service docs are the machine channel into the business register; durable standalone technical source.
Field-level financials from filed annual reports, but a paid/contracted re-use channel — human must clear commercial access.
eObjave is a continuously producing official announcement stream (registrations, insolvency, corporate events) — core A1 monitoring target.
Court-register document collection is a section of AJPES eObjave already covered by monitoring the parent.
Licence-clean bulk PRS open dataset on OPSI, refreshed regularly — the entity master list everything joins to.
SEOnet is the mandated regulated-information venue for LJSE issuers incl. NLB — highest-timeliness A1 stream.
English interface of the same SEOnet feed; a language variant of the parent, not a separate source.
Issuer roster is a directory to mine once for the seed list of disclosure-obligated Slovenian issuers.
Issuer financial calendar is genuinely useful for scheduling, but the exact deep link is unconfirmed — re-locate before approving.
A single rulebook PDF on the OAM storage mechanism — read once as documentation, not a recurring signal producer.
ATVP prospectus/issuer-report registers are high-value regulator primary sources; url_verification failed so re-check liveness first.
OAM.si is the free public register of issuers' audited annual/semi-annual reports — a second regulator-side A1 archive.
Single static Banka Slovenije PDF catalogue of PSD2 passporting notifications — payments-relevant evidence artefact, refreshed occasionally.
EU e-Justice gateway page describing the Slovenian register — mine once to confirm authoritative register mapping.
NLB's own IR announcements page is a durable issuer-side mirror with cleaner archives; useful redundancy to SEOnet.
SeeNews Slovenia feed systematically covers bank results, M&A and ratings in English — durable monitoring feed.
bne IntelliNews has dense Slovenian bank coverage but is largely subscription-gated; access must be cleared.
STA English service is the canonical national wire for Slovenian banking/economic news; monitor the feed (deep archive may be metered).
Free English national portal restating STA banking and payments stories — useful cross-check hub.
Low-authority aggregator, largely redundant with STA/Slovenia Times, and the URL did not verify — re-check before spending a slot.
Bloomberg Europe is valuable but hard-paywalled and bot-blocked; a human must settle access terms.
Reuters is the reference English version of Slovenian bank/sovereign events; headline-level access is public.
S&P Global MI newsroom is analyst-grade on CEE banking but partly gated and the URL failed verification — clear access, then re-check.
Fitch rating action commentaries on Slovenian banks are prime upstream documents but require free registration to read.
NLB Group English IR site — issuer's own authoritative disclosure, annual report and earnings layer; textbook A1 source.
Duplicate of the SEOnet English interface already captured; fold into the SEOnet parent entry.
Investegate holds NLB's RNS filings free and in English — unpaywalled mirror of Slovenian issuer disclosures.
Banka Slovenije English publications: highest-authority translated primary material on the banking and payments system.
